Idk if there's a more appropriate chat where to post a "review". I played up until the trick house, then decided to drop the game.
For starters, the game is too easy. You get Honedge as a starter and that mon alone eats half of the trainers' teams very easily. 
This wouldn't be a problem on its own but there are other factors that make the experience frustrating. 
The encounters are horribly balanced, there are types which you are very likely to not get, like Fighting and Electric (This one in particular is very bad because you get the Volt Switch TM) while you get a ton of water types because of how hoenn was designed. This could be solved easily by adding grass patches and think about the encounters a bit more.
The docs have many errors regarding the order in which the trainers appear in the game, which lead to several instances in which I risked more than one mon for no reason.
As for the final criticism, the trainers in the trick house not having their own sprites makes it almost unplayable. Combine this with the wrong docs and the whole location is a mess.
Thanks for review. I especially appreciate how you only focused on the negatives and over exaggerated all of your complaints 👍🏻
I can assure you that the Nuzlocke mode is not “too easy”. The non-nuzlocke mode is intended to be more casual by design

Either way. I understand some of your frustration, so thx for the feedback. You are not the first to comment on any of those things. All of those issues are pretty challenging to fix code-wise unfortunately. They will likely be fixed in a future update.
